kjv: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.

lines.say: Hurting tonight? This is for you.
He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds. Psalm one forty seven, verse three.
lines.big: He healeth the broken in heart, and bindeth up their wounds.

lines.say: He doesn't just see the broken heart. He binds it up.
lines.big: He doesn't just see the broken heart. He binds it up.

lines.say: Lord, heal my heart tonight and bind up the wounds. In Jesus' name, amen.
